Head of Product — BNPL, London hybrid.

Tally (London, 45 people, Series A, founder-led) offers buy-now-pay-later checkout for independent UK retailers and their shoppers. We're hiring a Head of Product to build and lead the product team as we grow — the exact team shape is still being decided with the founders. You'll own the shopper app, credit decisions at checkout and pricing tests on merchant fees. Hybrid, two days a week in our Shoreditch office. Ideally you've shipped consumer-credit product and are happy being hands-on with specs and SQL.
